Who We Are

Rooted in the
Tri-Cities

Vista Nova Landscaping LLC was founded in Kingsport, TN in 2021 with a simple mission: deliver honest, quality outdoor work that stands the test of time. We treat every property like our own.

From custom landscape installs and stone paver patios to french drain systems that solve real water problems, every project gets our full attention from first call to final walkthrough.

"We saw a gap in the market for truly crafted outdoor work — not cookie-cutter, but custom. Every yard has a story, and we help tell it."

Quality Materials

Durable, locally-suited materials built for Tennessee weather.

Clear Communication

No surprises on scope or pricing — ever.

Satisfaction Guaranteed

We don't leave until the job meets your expectations.

Locally Operated

We live here too. Supporting the Tri-Cities matters to us.

What We Do

Three Services.
Done Right.

We specialize — not generalize. Mastery in landscaping installs, hardscaping, and drainage on every project across the Tri-Cities.

Request a Quote
01

Landscaping Installs

Full-scope landscape transformations from bare ground to thriving outdoor environments designed for East Tennessee's climate and terrain.

  • Plant selection & professional installation
  • Mulch beds & decorative bed design
  • Trees, shrubs & ornamental plantings
  • Ground prep, topsoil & grading
  • Native & low-maintenance plant options
  • Seasonal color rotation planning
Get a Quote
02

Hardscaping

Structural outdoor improvements using concrete pavers, natural stone, and block systems — from entertainment patios to slope-stabilizing retaining walls.

  • Paver patios, walkways & pool surrounds
  • Retaining walls (block & natural stone)
  • Driveway paver installation
  • Garden edging & landscape borders
  • Steps, landings & grade transitions
  • Outdoor living area preparation
Get a Quote
03

Drainage Solutions

Protect your home's foundation and reclaim waterlogged yard space with engineered drainage systems built for East Tennessee's rainfall and hilly terrain.

  • French drain design & installation
  • Dry well systems & infiltration basins
  • Surface water redirection
  • Downspout & gutter drainage tie-ins
  • Erosion control measures
  • Foundation protection grading

How It Works

Simple Process,
Exceptional Results

From your first call to final cleanup — here's exactly what to expect when you work with Vista Nova.

Free Consultation

We visit your property, listen to your vision, assess site conditions, and answer every question — no pressure, no cost, no obligation.

Custom Proposal

You receive a detailed written estimate with scope, materials, timeline, and all-in pricing. Clear. Honest. No hidden fees.

Expert Installation

Our trained crew arrives on schedule, works cleanly, and executes your project with the craftsmanship it deserves.

Final Walkthrough

We walk through every detail with you before we consider the job done. Your complete satisfaction is the only standard we accept.
